notes.title: Your own Fleetwood Bounder
notes.content:
In our game loop, players focus on managing and customizing their camper, with a goal of selling it for a profit. One way to get the camper is by bidding it on the stock.

Players also have the option to repair their camper by completing multiple tasks, such as fixing the plumbing or replacing tires. Once the camper is repaired, players can renovate it using a special system that allows them to customize the interior and choose furniture.

After the camper is both repaired and renovated, players can take it on a journey to sell it and earn a profit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/a46c3506af3a74b2886ed7319af1556186e150a6.gif[/img]

We're excited to announce that the campers in American Camper Simulator are inspired by real-life models, giving players the chance to see and customize a variety of different campers in the game.

One of the first campers will be the Fleetwood Bounder. This iconic camper has been a staple of American road trips for decades, and players will have the opportunity to repair and renovate their own version of this classic model.

As players progress through the game, they'll come across many other campers, each with their own unique design and features. From compact and cozy models to spacious and luxurious ones, there's something for everyone in American Camper Simulator.

We'll see you on the road!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339490/American_Camper_Simulator/

notes.title: Home Sweet Home
notes.content:
Greetings players! 

It's a great adventure to travel in a camper, but still nowhere is as good as home! Unless your mansion has ventured in the middle of nowhere for years and, at the insistence of your screaming wife, it's time to start a little renovation…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/da72299a83a17091339d16602832befc303b03d6.gif[/img]

We've added a thrilling new feature to American Camper Simulator - House Renovation! Not only can you use your camper flipping earnings to make your house a more comfortable and attractive place, but the renovation system also represents your progress in the game.

The main character, who lives with his rude wife and has a daughter in college, is motivated to renovate their home in hopes of pleasing his wife and preparing for their daughter's future. As you invest in your house, you'll see the changes and improvements that reflect the progress you've made in the game.

With this feature, you can use your camper flipping profits towards adding rooms, redecorating, and making cosmetic upgrades to your house. As you progress through the game, you'll also be able to unlock even more renovation options and furniture options to make your house truly unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/3287f72df8b96a70455b3c8e6b147cc61f1fc4f0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/0dae8b654dd0b66062e39aba0104b73e869aaad4.jpg[/img]

We hope you'll enjoy this exciting new addition to American Camper Simulator!

Best regards,

The American Camper Simulator Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339490/American_Camper_Simulator/

notes.title: "The Law's the Law" in American Camper Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/a1aac01e7fc3a1410e33844aab6cee2dc74671fc.jpg[/img]

Do you hear those sirens? No? Exactly, Sheriff Sam never gives warnings. He'll catch you at the first opportunity.

We are excited to reveal a new NPC in our game, American Camper Simulator. Meet "Sheriff Sam," a main antagonist in the game who will play a prominent role in the player's journey.

Sheriff Sam is a cold and calculating individual who is tasked with enforcing the law. He has a legendary reputation in his role as a law enforcement officer, known for his strict adherence to the law and relentless pursuit of justice. In his past, he was a decorated veteran of the U.S. Border Patrol and later joined the state police force before becoming a sheriff. He has always been vigilant in tracking down criminals and is not known for his leniency.

He will often visit the player's workshop to search for anything illegal, adding an extra layer of challenge and tension to the game. As players renovate and upgrade their campers, they will need to be careful not to break any laws or they may face penalties from Sheriff Sam. In these encounters, players will have to hide any illegal items they may have in their workshop or camping spot to avoid getting caught by the Sheriff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/b7b21fc708decf6c856abb49ca69ba47fd809817.jpg[/img]

In addition to his role as a law enforcement officer, Sheriff Sam is also a specialist in cold weather camping. Players will encounter him in various locations across the game. His expertise in cold weather camping will add another layer of realism to the game and provide players with unique challenges to overcome.

We can't wait for players to experience the added depth and tension that Sheriff Sam brings to American Camper Simulator.

Happy renovating!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339490/American_Camper_Simulator/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif[/img]

notes.title: Camper life after dark
notes.content:
Welcome to the new, second part of our devlog. The accompanying smoke is the result of our hard work, no illegal activities in the back of the camper, we promise!

Today we would like to tell you a little about who you will meet on Route 66. Camping with decked-out campers can be an unforgettable adventure when you cut across the canyon and come across someone named Schrödinger. There are many rumors about his camper. Green clouds of smoke often obscure its exact location. Schrödinger was once a chemistry teacher, but now meeting him gives you chills when he looks at you coldly and asks you for his own name... and then with a smile asks if you can help him with the hydraulics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/c0d204f802f5d56b68189dad11881b4aa3662b2f.jpg[/img]

Schrödinger is a mysterious figure who hides many secrets. As a player, you will have multiple opportunities to meet him during your travels to tourist locations. Each time Schrödinger is nearby, he will have business with you. At first it will be innocent help with the camper septic tank, but over time he may want to use your knack for customizing campers. When he hands you the plans for his camper - don't ask questions. Take the money, do what you have to do, and pretend you never saw each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568844/651b021c036c16e9a05f471e5724da018f06b85b.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for players' first interactions with our former chemistry teacher and we hope you'll dive into the world of campers, not only learning about its superficial and family aspects, but also the dark side of business under the cover of night and high-risk during meetings in the middle of nowhere.

That's it for today, see you soon in the next devlog. Be careful when driving at night. And when someone knocks on the door of your vehicle, you know who it might be.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339490/American_Camper_Simulator/

notes.title: Rebranding
notes.content:
[h2]The first DevLog of American Camper Simulator[/h2]

[h3]We will start our journey together through the making of this nostalgic game![/h3]

At the very beginning, important information - as fans waiting for the game have already noticed, we decided to change the name of the game from "Camper Flipper" to "American Camper Simulator".

This is a symbolic but significant change for the philosophy of our production. We decided to take this step because during the work on the game we decided to rework the pillars to make sure that it would meet our assumptions and allow you to fully feel the atmosphere of camper life. We decided to focus primarily on the repair and renovation of our vehicle, references to storage wars and, last but not least, the aspect of experiencing adventures in our favorite camper.

The name "Camper Flipper" suggested gameplay focused mainly on economy and vehicle development. Changing the name of the game to "American Camper Simulator" allows us to highlight the most important features of the production. Faithful reproduction of the interaction with our camper and visiting the attractions of America.

Speaking of which, we're happy to let you know where our game is set. The player in "American Camper Simulator" will experience adventures along the legendary Route 66. It is the longest tourist road, running through several states. Along just one road, we can meet hundreds of pop-cultural attractions, monuments and get to know dozens of cultures. It is visiting Route 66 that will allow the player to learn more about the charms of America closer and immerse himself in the life of a good citizen who lives the American dream.

[b]Thank you very much for your attention and we hope to meet you in the campgrounds of America.[/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339490/American_Camper_Simulator/
